message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) based on facts. Facts: In a detention center (看守所) cell, inmate Li (李某) and victim Zhang (张某1) had a dispute, Li beat Zhang, causing rib fracture, classified as light injury (轻伤二级). So Li is a detainee (在押人员) who inflicted injury on another detainee. The appropriate charge is "故意伤害" (intentional injury). However there may be a specific charge for assault on a detainee: "虐待被监管人" (abuse of a person under supervision) is used when prison staff or guards assault detainees. But here the perpetrator is also a detainee, not a staff. So the appropriate charge is "故意伤害". In previous examples, when a guard beat a detainee, they used "虐待被监管人". For example: case with 方某某 (a guard) beating a detainee, they used "虐待被监管人". Here it's a detainee beating another detainee. So it's just intentional injury.

Thus answer: [罪名]故意伤害<eoa>

Check if any other charge like "聚众斗殴" (group fight) but only two persons. So just intentional injury.
